Jordan L. Martin  
Cedar Point Capital Partners - Legal  
500 Commerce Blvd, Suite 2100  
Chicago, Illinois 60606

Fax: 312.555.4822  
E-mail: jordan.martin@cedarpointcapital.com  

-----Original Message-----  
From:  caleb.turner@ridgeviewenergy.com  
Sent: Thursday, November 08, 2001 4:57 PM  
To: Martin, Jordan  
Subject: Updated Master Agreement  

Jordan,  

Finally, attached are the revised agreement versions, both in redline and final format. My instructions were to prepare execution copies, have them signed on behalf of the various Ridgeview entities, and they are currently being hand delivered to Mr. Simmons in your credit group for execution on behalf of the Cedar Point entities. I also prepared guaranty agreements from Ridgeview Holdings and from Cedar Point Capital Partners, each of which has been either executed or acknowledged on behalf of Ridgeview. The decision from senior management was that this final version is a "take it or leave it" offer for Cedar Point.  

A summary of the major changes:  

1. All margining provisions and references to collateral have been removed.  
2. All operative Underlying Master Agreements have been incorporated.  
3. The "Group" payment concept was eliminated in Section 4 due to ambiguity about the actual payer.  

Thank you.  

Caleb  
(See attached files: CedarPoint_MstrNet_11-8.doc, CedarPoint_MstrNet_11-8_Final.doc)
